items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: And with O'Gees. And after... I'd gone to New Orleans and lived a while. They would send for me from New Orleans to come over out here and play with him.

ctx.x: Well before that, I'm way ahead of my story. After with Paul Maurice. After with... O'Gees. As you... What's his name? August. August. August. August. August. August. August. August. August. August. And, however, I played with him. And likewise, Sunder. I played with both of those. Sunder Labatt. Yes. Sunder Labatt. And with O'Gees. And after... I'd gone to New Orleans and lived a while. They would send for me from New Orleans to come over out here and play with him. Oh. Now Buddy Bo.
